verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic customer notifications triggered by a feature request's status change. The closest items are adjacent: changelog announcements (canny-docs-8), manual status updates and replies via MCP (canny-docs-5), status sync with Jira, Linear and GitHub (canny-intdir-4/5/6), and Discord notifications aimed at the team (canny-intdir-1). None of these is the requested automated customer-facing notification, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
